post.description:
Upload a receipt or invoice file and return Taggun's broader verbose extraction response. Use this endpoint when you need product line items, per-field metadata, helper arrays, or account-enabled feature results in addition to the core receipt fields.

> 👍 Evaluating Taggun?
>
> This is the endpoint to test with. Attach a real receipt in the playground and select **Try It!**. Follow [Test With Your Own Receipts](/docs/testing-your-receipts) for a practical evaluation workflow.

Use a supported file type. A request-size limit applies; see [Document Types & File Requirements](/docs/document-types-and-files) for the current requirements.

See a complete [example verbose response](/reference/example), then use [Understanding Your Results](/docs/understanding-results) and [Data Fields That Taggun Extracts](/docs/data-fields-that-taggun-extracts) to interpret it.

file.description: Supported receipt or invoice file that meets the current [Document Types & File Requirements](/docs/document-types-and-files).

extractLineItems.description: Set to `false` to skip product line-item extraction. See [Line Item Extraction](/docs/line-item-extraction).

extractTime.description: Set to `true` to return the time when found on the receipt. Otherwise, time is set to 12:00:00.000.

language.description: Optional language hint; leave empty for automatic detection. Recommended for Arabic (`ar`), Khmer (`kh`), Thai (`th`), and Hebrew (`he`). Full code list: [Language detection and hints](/docs/global-coverage#language-detection-and-hints).

near.description: A location (city, state, country) to help search for the merchant.

ipAddress.description: End user's IP address, used for GeoIP lookup. When context is available, a verbose response can include a root `location` object for this IP; it is separate from the extracted merchant address.

ignoreMerchantName.description: Specify a merchant name to ignore if it is detected on the file, such as a customer name mistaken for the merchant.

refresh.description: Set to `true` to force reprocessing if the receipt is already stored.

incognito.description: Per-request storage opt-out. See [Security, Privacy & Data Residency](/docs/security-and-privacy#per-request-storage-opt-out-incognito).

userId.description: End-user identifier associated with the submission and returned with matched receipts, when available, so cross-user reuse can be investigated.

containerId.description: Scopes [duplicate and similarity checks](/docs/duplicate-and-similarity-detection) to scans with the same caller-defined value. Omit to compare account-wide.

subAccountId.description: Attribute usage to a client or other subdivision within your Taggun account for reporting. This does not create a separate Taggun account or subscription.

Useful where multipart uploads are awkward (queue pipelines, some serverless platforms). Only need totals? Use [Encoded File (simple)](/reference/encoded-file-simple).

Authentication and common parameters are defined once in the [Taggun API Reference](/reference/overview).
